goal: Build Windows-parity Linux Web UI Dashboard and Native Chromium CDP Automated Cookie Interceptor for Direct TeraBox Sign-In
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Develop full Windows-parity Web UI dashboard matching the PureBlack desktop layout (Disks, Transfers, Settings, Analytics) on http://127.0.0.1:8899.
2. Implement direct TeraBox browser sign-in and automated cookie capture using Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) over pure-Python RFC 6455 WebSockets without external dependencies.
3. Add 'ui' CLI action and '--browser' sign-in option to src/cli/nsclouddrive.ps1.
5. Verify all automated tests pass with exit code 0.

decisions.decision: Use standard library Python ThreadingHTTPServer and RFC 6455 WebSocket client.
decisions.rationale: Eliminates third-party pip dependencies on the Linux VPS while providing fast, reliable CDP communication.

decisions.decision: Launch Chromium with --app=https://www.terabox.com/ and --remote-debugging-port=9224 on DISPLAY=:1.
decisions.rationale: Displays an application-mode login window identical to Windows WebView2, allowing users to sign in directly while CDP intercepts cookies in the background.

decisions.decision: Replicate Windows PureBlack theme and UI hierarchy in single-bundle responsive HTML/CSS/JS.
decisions.rationale: Provides instant load times, zero missing assets, and 1:1 visual parity with the Windows WPF desktop interface.

reviewFindings.notes: Verified RFC 6455 framing, CDP token safety, strict mode compliance, absence of plaintext credentials in logs, and responsive layout. All 22 Web UI tests and 71 E2E tests passed cleanly.
